hrm.employees.title: Employee records
hrm.employees.empty_description: Employee records of the org units in scope show here.
hrm.employee.user_login_hint: Login of the account linked to this employee; leave empty if there is none.
hrm.employee.section.main_hint: Who the employee is and where they sit in the organisation.
hrm.employee.section.personal_hint: Basic personal details, visible to anyone who can view the record.
hrm.employees.description: Employee records in the org units you have access to.
hrm.employee.section.sensitive_hint: Encrypted. Only users with the permission can see it, and every view is logged.
hrm.leaves.title: Leave requests
hrm.leaves.description: Your own leave requests, those of the people you manage, and those in your scope.
hrm.leaves.create_description: Create a draft, check it, then send it for approval.
hrm.leaves.empty_description: Leave requests in the org units in scope show here.
hrm.leave.working_days: The chosen range holds {{days}} working day(s).
hrm.leave.type_max_days: This kind allows at most {{days}} day(s) per request.
hrm.leave.type_needs_attachment: This kind needs a supporting document before the request is sent.
hrm.leave.reason_hint: Do not enter diagnoses or other health information.
hrm.leave.section_hint: A request takes effect only once approved.
hrm.leave_type.title: Kinds of leave
hrm.leave_type.description: The kinds of leave used in leave requests. Deducting kinds take days from the balance once approved.
hrm.leave_type.name: Name
hrm.leave_type.deducts_hint: E.g. annual leave. Sick or unpaid leave does not.
hrm.leave_type.active_hint: Clear to retire it; existing requests keep it.
hrm.leave_type.empty_description: Add at least one kind (e.g. annual leave) before employees file requests.
hrm.balance.no_permission: No permission to view this employee's leave balance.
hrm.overtimes.title: Overtime requests
hrm.overtimes.description: Your own overtime requests, those of the people you manage, and those in your scope.
hrm.overtimes.create_description: Create a draft, check it, then send it for approval.
hrm.overtimes.empty_description: Overtime requests in the org units in scope show here.
hrm.overtime.section_hint: Each request holds the overtime of one day. It takes effect once approved.
hrm.overtime.day_kind_hint: Pick it from the company's work calendar; it sets the overtime rate.
hrm.overtime.night_hint: The part worked between 10 pm and 6 am.
hrm.contract.create_description: A new contract for {{name}}. Create a draft and send it for approval; it takes effect once approved.
hrm.contract.new_appendix_description: An appendix replaces the salary and every line of the contract from its effective date.
hrm.contract.empty_description: The employee's contracts and appendices show here.
hrm.contract.section_hint: The kind and term of the contract.
hrm.contract.section_appendix_hint: An appendix keeps the kind and term of its original contract.
hrm.contract.section_terms_hint: Monthly amounts in đồng. Sensitive: every view is recorded.
hrm.contract_type.title: Contract kinds
hrm.contract_type.description: The kinds used on employment contracts and in approval rules.
hrm.contract_type.name: Name
hrm.contract_type.active_hint: Clear to retire it; existing contracts keep it.
hrm.contract_type.empty_description: Add at least one (e.g. indefinite, fixed-term) before creating contracts.
hrm.contracts.title: Employment contracts
hrm.contracts.description: Contracts and appendices in your scope. Create new ones from the employee's record.
hrm.contracts.empty_description: Contracts are made from the Contracts tab of an employee's record.
hrm.contract_type.fixed_term_hint: Contracts of this kind need an end date. Clear it for open-ended kinds.
hrm.contract.end_date_required_hint: This kind of contract has a fixed term.
hrm.timesheets.title: Timesheets
hrm.timesheets.description: Days actually worked, by org unit and payroll period.
hrm.timesheets.empty_description: Each timesheet covers one org unit and one month.
hrm.timesheet.grid: Days worked by employee and day
hrm.timesheet.grid_hint: Enter 1 for a full day and 0.5 for half a day; leave days not worked blank. Leave and public holidays are not entered here. Arrow keys move between cells.
hrm.timesheet.grid_hint_read: Days actually worked by each employee; grey cells are outside their employment.
hrm.timesheet.warning.work_on_day_off: Tinted cells fall on a day off in the work calendar: that work is not paid. Work on a day off needs an overtime request.
hrm.timesheet.warning.work_on_leave_day: Tinted cells fall on a day of approved leave: the leave still takes the balance and the work earns nothing more. Check the work or the leave request.
hrm.timesheet.cell_warning.work_on_day_o: Day off: not paid without an overtime request
hrm.timesheet.cell_warning.work_on_leave: Approved leave already covers this day
hrm.timesheet.no_employees: No employee of this org unit works during this period.
hrm.timesheet.invalid_cells: Some cells are not valid: each takes 0.5 or 1 only.
hrm.timesheet.import_hint: The file replaces every day of this draft timesheet. Columns: employee code, full name, then one column per day of the period (01/03, 02/03…). Export to Excel to get the employees listed, then fill in that file.
hrm.employees.import_balances_hint: Each row adds days to one employee's leave balance of a year (negative to take away). Columns: employee code, year, days, reason. If any row is wrong, no row is written.
hrm.leave_type.paid_hint: Days of this leave count as paid days (e.g. annual leave). Leave paid by social insurance, such as sick leave, is not.
hrm.leave_type.max_days_hint: Leave empty for no limit. E.g. at most 3 days for one's own marriage. A longer request cannot be saved.
hrm.leave_type.requires_attachment_hint: E.g. a medical certificate for sick leave. A draft saves without one, but cannot be sent until a file is attached.
hrm.calendar.title: Work calendar & holidays
hrm.calendar.description: Weekly days off and holidays of a legal entity: what standard and paid days go by.
hrm.calendar.no_entities: No legal entity whose calendar you may change.
hrm.calendar.default_week: No version yet: Saturday and Sunday off.
hrm.calendar.effective_from_hint: Applies until the day before the next version.
hrm.calendar.name: Name
hrm.calendar.delete_week: The version from {{date}} will be deleted; the one before it applies again.
hrm.legal_param.title: Legal parameters
hrm.legal_param.description: Rates, caps, deductions and tax brackets by effective date. A payroll uses the version in force on its last day.
hrm.legal_param.value_hint: Decimals use a dot (0.08). Tax brackets: [[upper bound, rate], …], the last bound null.
hrm.legal_param.si_employer: Social insurance rate, employer (with occupational accident)
hrm.legal_param.insurance_skip_days: Unpaid days from which no insurance is due
hrm.payrolls.title: Payrolls
hrm.payrolls.description: Payrolls by period and legal entity. Posting one closes the period to every source document.
hrm.payrolls.empty_description: A payroll is made once the period's timesheets are posted.
hrm.payroll.month_hint: Every org unit with employees on the payroll needs a posted timesheet of this period.
hrm.payroll.compute_failed: The payroll could not be computed
hrm.payroll.not_computed: The payroll is not computed yet. Click Compute again.
hrm.payroll.sources_changed_hint: Contracts, timesheets, leave, overtime, the work calendar or parameters changed since the computation. Compute again before sending.
hrm.payroll.warning.work_on_leave_day: a day both worked and on approved leave
hrm.payroll.adjustments_hint: Back pay (positive) or recovery (negative) of a closed period. Taxable, not insured. Saving computes the payroll again.

hrm.common.search_request_hint: Number, employee code or name, then Enter
hrm.contract.section_lines_hint: Allowances (position, responsibility, hazard…) are insured and taxable; supports (fuel, phone, meals…) are not insured.

hrm.leave.no_deduct: This kind of leave does not use annual leave
hrm.leave.overlapping_none: No one in the department is away over these days.
hrm.employee.terminate_confirm: Terminate {{name}} with {{date}} as the last working day? From the next day the employee shows as terminated.
